ideas.pitch: An automated workflow engine built on n8n that continuously checks cloud infrastructure and application logs against RBI and SEBI compliance guidelines, auto-generating audit reports and remediation PRs.
ideas.title: N8n Automated Compliance Auditor for Indian Fintech Startups
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the explicit n8n Pro Plan prize incentive by building a practical, enterprise-grade workflow automation tool that appeals directly to judges looking for business viability and incubation potential.

ideas.pitch: A graph-based risk assessment platform for rural micro-entrepreneurs and farmers using alternative transaction data, combining network intelligence with lightGBM to unlock institutional credit.
ideas.title: AgriCredit Flow: Alternative Credit Scoring via Supply Chain Graph Analytics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs genuinely hard graph engineering and machine learning, directly mirroring winning architectures like Bito's AML risk detection platform.

ideas.pitch: A localized voice-first multilingual AI agent that assists frontline healthcare workers in rural areas with preliminary symptom checks, vaccination tracking, and regional outbreak alerts.
ideas.title: AyurSync: Multilingual AI Health Navigator for Rural Clinics
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the proven pattern of winning socially impactful regional health projects like SAGACITY, prioritizing clear measurable community benefit and accessibility.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous data pipeline incident investigator that detects schema breaks and corrupt data feeds across campus administrative databases, creating verified repair scripts and DataHub audit logs.
ideas.title: CampusPulse: Automated Institutional Data Lineage and Incident Response
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the complex automated data engineering and self-healing agent architecture that won the DataHub Agent Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An edge-computed computer vision pipeline running on low-cost hardware that classifies recyclables instantly, tied to an automated conveyor diverter for municipal waste management.
ideas.title: EcoSort Edge: Real-Time IoT Waste Stream Segregation System
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines physical hardware simulation with robust machine learning, replicating the multi-disciplinary technical execution seen in TechnoMorph Hackathon winners.
